name: strapi-astro-starter
description: Headless CMS starter: Strapi 5 + Astro 7, content-driven navigation, dynamic forms, Tailwind CSS v4.

scripts.dev: concurrently --names CMS,WEB --prefix-colors green,blue "npm run dev:cms" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix cms install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.setup: npm --prefix cms run setup && npm --prefix frontend run setup
scripts.build: npm --prefix cms run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
